“别看翼盟如今只有三十二人，但在内门之中，都是响当当的大人物。”
“并且翼盟极为同心，视成员如手足，敢动翼盟成员者，无论是谁他们都会报复。”
“两年前，青州一座三等宗门，就是因为伤了翼盟成员，而被灭门的，出手的正是翼盟。”
“竟如此厉害？”听到这里，楚枫也是感到吃惊，虽说三等宗门远不如青龙宗，但也至少是一方势力，能够将它灭门，可想而知那翼盟的确很强。
“还有，别看天下盟和剑道盟的创始人很厉害，但跟翼盟的创始人比，根本就不入流。”
“相传，那翼盟的创始人，十一岁进入内门，十四岁便被成为核心弟子，十六岁已是青龙宗第一弟子。”
“不过可惜，他志不在青龙宗，十六岁那年便离开了这里，没人知道他的去向。”谈及此事，弟弟颇显遗憾。
“此人叫做什么？”楚枫倍感吃惊，核心弟子，那可是青龙宗的重点培养对象，每个都可谓是修武奇才。
而那翼盟的创始人，十六岁便无敌于核心弟子之间，那此人究竟是何其了得？
“他叫做张天翼。”弟弟一字一句的说出了这个名字。
“张天翼。”楚枫记下了这个名字，因为他有被楚枫记下的资格，
“对了，听说我内门的美女长老苏柔，便是翼盟的第一批成员，也曾是核心弟子最强的几人之一。”
“并且，除了苏柔长老，如今核心弟子之中，也有很多翼盟的人，每个人的成就，都不逊色于天下盟和剑道盟的创始人，你说这翼盟厉害不？”弟弟继续讲道。
“这样说来，这翼盟还真是厉害，那么翼盟成员有什么特殊的标志没？”楚枫对这翼盟越发感起兴趣。
“翼盟的人很少见到，不过他们每个人的胸口，都会佩戴一枚勋章，那勋章上面绘着一对翅膀。”弟弟讲道。
三人边走边聊，很快便抵达一座人潮涌动的广场，这里便是报名灵药狩猎的地方。
其实所谓的报名，就是在广场的条幅上，写上自己的名字，然后抽取一块令牌，根本就没有长老招待。
“这位师弟，明日灵药狩猎就开始了，想必你是要加入同盟以求庇护的。”
“所以我劝你一句，像翼盟那种同盟，就别想了，因为咱们一辈子也进不去。”

“别说翼盟，就算天下盟和剑道盟，也都不是那么好进的。”。
“所以说，你若是想加入同盟，一定要擦亮眼睛。”报名之后，兄弟俩又凑了过来。
“还请两位师兄指点。”见这对兄弟如此热心，楚枫也不忍博了他们的面子。
“虽然太强的同盟进不去，但也不能选择太弱的，像那些挨个介绍自己的同盟有多好的，千万不能进，这些同盟根本保护不了你，只能让你受欺负。”
“比如那边那个到处发竹片的丫头，一看就是某个弱小同盟的人，又在欺骗新来的弟子了。”说话间，哥哥将手指向了不远处，一位紫衣少女。
而顺着他所指的方向望去，楚枫却是不由一愣，因为那位紫衣少女，竟是楚月。
“楚月姐。”见状，楚枫激动的呼喊起来。
听见楚枫的呼喊，楚月也是回头观望，看到楚枫后同样大喜，一边挥手一边喊道：“楚枫弟。”
楚枫正急着找楚月，想不到竟在此处相遇，赶忙快步的向楚月走了过去。
“哎，完了，又一个傻蛋被骗了，咱们两个跟他讲了那么多，算是白讲了。”见状，这对兄弟四目相对，摇了摇头。
“楚枫弟，你终于进入内门了，太好了，我们姐弟终于能够一起修炼了。”打量着楚枫身上的紫色长袍，楚月满心欢喜，开心的都跳了起来，她是发自内心的为楚枫高兴。
“楚月姐，你这是做什么呢？”看着楚月手中的竹片，楚枫很是好奇。
“喔，你还不知道吧，楚威大哥在内门创建了一个同盟，叫做楚盟。”
“如今咱楚家的同辈人，都在这个楚盟里，不过就算这样，楚盟的人还是太少。”
“这不，趁着今年新生弟子进入内门，我想多拉拢一些人加入咱楚盟，壮大势力，毕竟如果楚盟发展的好，日后对咱楚家也会有很大帮助。”楚月笑着解释。
而楚月口中的楚威，是楚家年轻一辈的老大，今年二十岁，十年前便拜入了青龙宗。

"Although there are only thirty-two people in the Wing Alliance now, among the inner sect, they are all well-known big shots."
"And the Wing Alliance is extremely united and treats its members as brothers. If anyone dares to touch a member of the Wing Alliance, they will retaliate no matter who they are."
"Two years ago, a third-class sect in Qingzhou was exterminated because it injured a member of the Wing Alliance. It was the Wing Alliance who took action."
"So powerful?" Hearing this, Chu Feng was also surprised. Although the third-class sect was far inferior to the Qinglong Sect, it was at least a force that could destroy it. It can be imagined that the Wing Alliance was indeed very strong.
"Also, although the founders of the Tianxia League and the Sword League are very powerful, compared with the founders of the Wing League, they are not popular at all."
"According to legend, the founder of the Wing Alliance entered the inner sect at the age of eleven, was made a core disciple at the age of fourteen, and became the first disciple of the Qinglong Sect at the age of sixteen."
"But it's a pity that his ambition was not in the Qinglong Sect. He left here when he was sixteen years old. No one knows his whereabouts." When talking about this matter, the younger brother looked quite regretful.
"What is this person's name?" Chu Feng was doubly surprised. The core disciples were the key training targets of the Qinglong Sect, and each of them could be said to be a martial arts genius.
And the founder of the Wing Alliance was invincible among the core disciples at the age of sixteen. So what is so great about this person?
"His name is Zhang Tianyi." The younger brother said the name word for word.
"Zhang Tianyi." Chu Feng wrote down this name because he was qualified to be written down by Chu Feng.
"By the way, I heard that Su Rou, the beautiful elder of my inner sect, was one of the first members of the Wing Alliance and was once one of the strongest core disciples."
"Furthermore, in addition to Elder Su Rou, there are also many people from the Wing Alliance among the core disciples. The achievements of each of them are not inferior to those of the founders of the Tianxia Alliance and the Sword Alliance. Do you think this Wing Alliance is powerful?" the younger brother continued.
"In this way, this Wing Alliance is really powerful, so do the members of the Wing Alliance have any special signs?" Chu Feng became more and more interested in this Wing Alliance.
"It is rare to see people from the Wing Alliance, but each of them will wear a medal on their chest, with a pair of wings painted on the medal." said the younger brother.
The three of them walked and chatted, and soon arrived at a crowded square, where people signed up for the elixir hunt.
In fact, the so-called registration is to write your name on the banner in the square, and then draw a token. There is no elders to entertain you at all.
"Junior brother, the elixir hunting will begin tomorrow. You must join the alliance to seek protection."
"So I advise you, don't even think about an alliance like the Wing Alliance, because we will never be able to enter it in our lifetime."
"Don't talk about the Wing Alliance, even the Tianxia Alliance and the Sword Alliance are not that easy to enter.".
"So, if you want to join the alliance, you must keep your eyes open." After signing up, the two brothers came over again.
"Please give me some advice from my two senior brothers." Seeing how enthusiastic these two brothers were, Chu Feng couldn't bear to lose their face.
"Although alliances that are too strong cannot enter, you cannot choose alliances that are too weak. For example, alliances that tell you how good they are one by one must not be entered. These alliances cannot protect you at all and can only make you bullied."
"For example, that girl over there who is handing out pieces of bamboo everywhere, she is someone from a weak alliance who is deceiving the new disciples again." As he spoke, the elder brother pointed his finger at a girl in purple not far away.
Looking in the direction he pointed, Chu Feng couldn't help but be startled, because the girl in purple was actually Chu Yue.
"Sister Chu Yue." Seeing this, Chu Feng shouted excitedly.
Hearing Chu Feng's call, Chu Yue also turned around to look around. When she saw Chu Feng, she was equally overjoyed, waving her hands and shouting: "Brother Chu Feng."
Chu Feng was looking for Chu Yue in a hurry, but he didn't expect to meet him here, so he hurriedly walked towards Chu Yue.
"Hey, it's over, another fool has been deceived. The two of us have talked to him so much, but it's all in vain." Seeing this, the brothers looked at each other and shook their heads.
"Brother Chu Feng, you have finally entered the inner sect. It's great. We, sister and brother, can finally practice together." Looking at the purple robe on Chu Feng's body, Chu Yue was filled with joy and jumped up with joy. She was happy for Chu Feng from the bottom of her heart.
"Sister Chu Yue, what are you doing?" Looking at the bamboo pieces in Chu Yue's hand, Chu Feng was very curious.
"Oh, you don't know yet, but Brother Chu Wei has created an alliance in the inner sect called the Chu Alliance."
"Now our Chu family contemporaries are all in this Chu League, but even so, there are still too few people in the Chu League."
"No, while the new disciples enter the inner sect this year, I want to recruit more people to join our Chu League and strengthen our power. After all, if the Chu League develops well, it will also be of great help to our Chu family in the future." Chu Yue explained with a smile.
The Chu Wei in Chu Yue's mouth is the eldest son of the younger generation of the Chu family. He is twenty years old this year and joined the Qinglong Sect ten years ago.
